cohort: 634 neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care units of comprehensive specialized hospitals in the Northwest Amhara Region, Ethiopia, between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: The incidence of acute kidney injury among NICU neonates was 14.9 per 1000, with prematurity, sepsis, perinatal asphyxia, gentamicin use, hyponatremia, and hyperkalemia identified as significant predictors.
